local world = require('openmw.world')
local types = require('openmw.types')
local done = false
local function update()
    if done then return end
    local player = world.players[1]
    if not player then return end
    local before = types.Player.getCrimeLevel(player)
    assert(before == -3 or before == -4)
    if before == -3 then types.Player.setCrimeLevel(player, -4) end
    assert(types.Player.getCrimeLevel(player) == -4)
    print('M15 bounty Lua before=' .. before .. ' after=-4')
    done = true
end
return {{engineHandlers={{onUpdate=update,onSave=function() return {{done=done}} end,onLoad=function() done=false end}}}}

local self = require('openmw.self')
local types = require('openmw.types')
local I = require('openmw.interfaces')
local done = false
local function update()
 if done then return end
 local before = types.NPC.stats.reputation(self).current
 assert(before == 16777219)
 print('M15 Fame Lua before=' .. before .. ' after=16777219')
 I.UI.addMode(I.UI.MODE.QuickKeysMenu)
 print('M15 quickkeys opened')
 done=true
end
return {{engineHandlers={{onUpdate=update,onSave=function() return {{done=done}} end,onLoad=function() done=false end}}}}
